dialogueText: Will Dad be surprised that I've suddenly arrived here?
I almost forgot, I need to let my friend know I've arrived.
The cool sea breeze. Simply the best.
*opening the door, but it is locked
Why is it locked? Isn't Dad inside?
Hmm... Maybe Dad is somewhere near the beach?
Maybe Dad is somewhere near the beach?
My head... What is this pressure?
There is something strange about that swing.
I noticed something wrong with this swing earlier.
Did the strap snap? Is it supposed to be like this, or what?
Wait, why is the door opened? Is Dad inside?
Wow, this place hasn't changed much!
Wait, I need to lower my voice. I want to surprise Dad.
*opening the door, but it is locked
Why is it broken like this?
It looks like I can put it back together.
I wonder when I took this photo?!
Oh my God, I can't remember it.
Anyway, where on earth is Dad?
Hmm... I'll go look for Dad outside again. Maybe he's out there.
How did it suddenly end up like this?
Wait, why is the door locked? What happened?!
This isn't funny anymore. DAD! WHERE ARE YOU?
OH MY GOD! WHAT IS ACTUALLY GOING ON HERE?
WHY did this room suddenly... get a hole in it...
